name: ULM Harness Spike
description: ULM controlled agent harness: base WS link service (register/heartbeat/11 commands/7 endpoints) + AgentHarness (id: ulm-controlled) running the ULM controlled loop.

wsUrl.description: ULM base WebSocket URL (default ws://localhost:8080 or ULM_WS_URL)

agents.description: ULM agents to link; each gets one base WS connection

agentId.description: ULM base agentId (must be registered in agent_registry)

openclawAgentId.description: OpenClaw-side agent id when different from base agentId
